ios.desc:
Kokua Steps helps you make a visual schedule that can guide and reward kids who need a little more motivation to achieve the their goals.

If you have challenges at certain times of day - breakfast, getting dressed, getting to school, independent play, meal times, bed times - you can make a visual schedule that will guide your and your child through the process. Each activity is broken down into Sections and Steps, making progress feel really achievable. No more arguments about socks, or brushing teeth, or finishing dinner!

Each step in your visual schedule can have a number of Stars assigned to it, and your child will earn stars for successfully completing the step. Stars can be tracked by day, week, month, or total so that you can set up goals and track progress for more motivation.

Neuro-atypical kids such as those with Autism, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, or Opposition Defiance Disorder, are particularly likely to need extrinsic motivation. A colorful, animated, visual guide like Kokua Steps provides a helping hand through less preferred tasks that can be especially helpful when working with these disabilities.

Get a little help with your little ones, guide them to success with Kokua Steps.

quotes.text:
I was let go from Google in January, I started work on an iPad app: a visual schedule for neuro-atypical children to help them with tasks:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kokua-steps/id6450752938

I shipped a rough v 1.0 a couple months ago, it has had FOUR downloads total .

If you have a kid with autism or ADHD it may help you.
